question: Among patients diagnosed with SLE who have abnormal LDH levels, what is the ratio of inpatients to outpatients, and who is the oldest among them? Return the ratio, ID, and sex of the oldest patient.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p."XCL_058" AS pid,
    p."XCL_059" AS sex,
    p."XCL_060" AS birth
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
  WHERE p."XCL_064" LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND l."XCL_018" > 500
),
ratio AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e."XCL_013" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
         NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e."XCL_013" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio
  FROM eligible AS b
  JOIN Examination AS e ON b.pid = e."XCL_001"
),
oldest AS (
  SELECT pid, sex
  FROM eligible
  ORDER BY birth ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  r.inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio AS ratio,
  o.pid AS id,
  o.sex AS sex
FROM ratio AS r
CROSS JOIN oldest AS o

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_058" AS pid, T1."XCL_059" AS sex, T1."XCL_060" AS birth
  FROM Patient AS T1
  INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
  WHERE T1."XCL_064" LIKE '%SLE%' AND T2."XCL_016" >= 60
),
ratio AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3."XCL_005" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
         SUM(CASE WHEN T3."XCL_005" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r
  FROM base AS b
  INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON b.pid = T3."XCL_001"
),
oldest AS (
  SELECT pid, sex FROM base ORDER BY birth ASC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ratio.r AS ratio, oldest.pid AS id, oldest.sex AS sex
FROM ratio CROSS JOIN oldest

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH sle_abnormal_ldh AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
        p.XCL_063 AS sex,
        p.XCL_060 AS birth_date,
        e.XCL_007 AS is_inpatient
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
    WHERE e.XCL_009 = 'SLE'
      AND l.XCL_020 > 250  -- Assuming normal LDH upper limit is 250 U/L
),
ratio_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_inpatient = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_inpatient = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio
    FROM sle_abnormal_ldh
),
oldest_patient AS (
    SELECT 
        patient_id,
        sex,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY birth_date ASC) AS rn
    FROM sle_abnormal_ldh
)
SELECT 
    r.inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio,
    o.patient_id,
    o.sex
FROM ratio_calc r
CROSS JOIN oldest_patient o
WHERE o.rn = 1
